description:
Are hyenas more dangerous than lions? For one stick man alone on foot all night on the African savanna, yes. In one crater, more than eight in ten of the meals lions were seen eating had been killed by hyenas. Doug spends a night, dusk to dawn, finding out why: bone-crushing jaws, five-kilometer chases, clans of over a hundred, a city where hyenas are fed by hand, and the moment the lions walk away. (Across Africa, lions kill more people than hyenas do; this one is about Doug.)

Where should we send Doug next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you're here for Doug's next bad night out.
